capabilities: Show one dash per heading on an editor-edge rail
Preview a section's heading and opening lines on hover
Scroll to a heading on click
Open a full indented outline panel with heading search
Toggle focus mode and hover line highlight for the gogoga theme
disambiguation: Not a list outliner; it only navigates and previews the headings of the open note.
extras: The focus mode and hover highlight commands only do something under the gogoga theme; wave constants and timings can be tuned at the top of main.js; the interface follows Obsidian's language setting (English or Simplified Chinese).
motivation: Built as a companion to the gogoga theme, in the style of Codex's document navigator.
problem: Long notes lack a compact, always-visible way to see where you are among headings and jump between sections without opening a separate outline pane.

relations.evidence: in the style of Codex's document navigator
switch on writing effects built into the gogoga theme

summary: Heading rail on the editor edge with a dash per heading, hover section previews, and click-to-scroll navigation.
